newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says to keep watch on currency moves.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says to keep watch on currency moves.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Thursday he will keep close watch on currency movements after the dollar's strengthening not only against the yen but also against the mark.
"It's a unilateral rise of the dollar," he told parliament's Lower House. "However, currency stability is needed for the Japanese economy, and an excessively weak or strong yen is not good," he said.
"We will keep close watch on currency movements with deep interest," he said. He added that Japan's economic fundamentals are "not bad at all".
